WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent
  FROM Customer c
  LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId
), customer_shares AS (
  SELECT total_spent, total_spent / NULLIF(SUM(total_spent) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM customer_totals
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM customer_shares
)
SELECT AVG(cs.total_spent) AS average_amount_spent,
       AVG(cs.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(cs.share - a.avg_share) AS average_share_above_average
FROM customer_shares cs
CROSS JOIN average_share a
WHERE cs.share > a.avg_share;
